observation: Shatter event appears to produce only faint crack streaks with little to no flying shard field; impact energy reads extremely low and the projectile (brick) is not clearly interacting with the pane.
expected_behavior: A heavy brick hits the center of the pane at high speed causing an explosive outward burst of many shards, with the brick continuing through trailing fragments; remaining glass in the frame should crack and partially collapse.
actual_behavior: Window remains largely intact/dark with minimal visible fracture detail; few/no shards eject outward; brick/impact is hard to read and does not clearly penetrate; no visible secondary collapse at frame edges.
